checks: Read complete original agency, financial-model, pilot, counsel, hold and third-party boundary messages supporting these findings; checked referenced spreadsheet rows with column headings.

Searched direct IRS-sender messages through the cutoff, and top-level messages concerning closure, hold release, final invoices, approved budgets and later remediation; identified and corrected the newer September23 agency record.

Checked actual reference-skill status/closure instructions; exercises remain bounded simulated work products rather than live actions.
issues_resolved: Corrected latest agency report from September6 to September23 after discovering EMAIL1065 outside the authored preferred evidence.
Added explicit penalties/interest exclusion and purposive/non-retrospective testing proofs; retained September6 fixture age separately.
Expanded minimally sufficient quoted spans so unrelated trailing prose is not required for credit; preserved substantive auditor/report-date obligations.
limitations: Independent agent review, not licensed legal or financial advice. Supplied corpus and benchmark rules only.
Standalone undated documents remain supplied references; historical availability is not established by their presence. These gold proofs use eligible email/attachment dates.
Global OCR/embedded-media extraction is not fully human-verified. Missing extraction is never proof of absence.
Unknown fields are qualified to the task fixture and available evidence, not a universal claim that no external decision exists.
Finite reviewed proof alternatives and bounded structured outputs need blinded model calibration before broad training/evaluation claims.
